complexityAnalysis.taskTitle: Update Package Dependencies for Pi-Controller Integration
complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Break down dependency installation into: 1) Add core dependencies (socket.io-client, zustand, axios, framer-motion, @sentry/react), 2) Update vite.config.ts for Socket.io proxy, 3) Configure environment variables setup, 4) Test build process and dependency compatibility
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: Simple dependency addition to existing React 18.3.1 setup. Vite config already exists and just needs proxy configuration. Most dependencies are standard React ecosystem packages.

complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Structure authentication implementation: 1) Create src/features/auth directory structure, 2) Implement AuthProvider with React Context, 3) Set up JWT session management with refresh logic, 4) Create ProtectedRoute component for React Router integration, 5) Build authentication API client with axios interceptors, 6) Implement logout functionality with token cleanup
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: High complexity due to security requirements, JWT handling, and integration with existing TanStack Query architecture. No existing auth infrastructure found in codebase.

complexityAnalysis.taskTitle: Design Authentication UI Components with shadcn/ui
complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Design authentication UI components: 1) Create LoginForm with shadcn/ui Form components, 2) Build RegisterForm with react-hook-form and zod validation, 3) Design UserProfile component with Avatar and Badge, 4) Implement session management UI with Toast notifications, 5) Add loading states and error handling with Alert components
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: Medium complexity as shadcn/ui components are already set up. Forms need validation integration with react-hook-form and zod which are already dependencies.

complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Implement Socket.io real-time layer: 1) Create useSocket.ts hook for connection management, 2) Implement automatic reconnection with exponential backoff, 3) Set up event listeners for GPIO and cluster updates, 4) Integrate with TanStack Query for optimistic updates, 5) Build connection status indicator component, 6) Handle connection errors with Sonner notifications
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: High complexity due to real-time state synchronization, reconnection logic, and integration with existing TanStack Query. No existing Socket.io infrastructure found.

complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Build GPIO control system: 1) Create src/features/gpio directory with control components, 2) Implement GPIOControlPanel with Switch, Button, and Slider components, 3) Design pin state visualization with color-coded indicators, 4) Build GPIO pin grid layout with Card and Badge components, 5) Add safety confirmations with AlertDialog components
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: Medium-high complexity for specialized hardware interface. Requires custom state management and safety features. Benefits from existing shadcn/ui components.

complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Integrate cluster management: 1) Extend existing ClusterCard and ClusterOverview components for pi-controller data, 2) Create cluster configuration forms with Select, Input, and Checkbox components, 3) Implement cluster creation workflow with multi-step forms, 4) Add cluster monitoring dashboard with real-time metrics and Chart components
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: Lower complexity due to existing well-structured ClusterCard and ClusterOverview components. Main work is extending existing patterns rather than creating from scratch.

complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Implement navigation and routing: 1) Update App.tsx routing for /auth, /gpio, /nodes, /profile routes, 2) Create unified navigation component with NavigationMenu, 3) Implement breadcrumb navigation with Breadcrumb component, 4) Add mobile-responsive navigation with Sheet sidebar, 5) Integrate authentication state for role-based menu visibility
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: Medium complexity. Simple React Router structure exists but needs extension. Navigation components available in shadcn/ui but require integration with auth state.

complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Establish state management: 1) Create custom hooks using TanStack Query for API data, 2) Implement selective Zustand stores for GPIO and connection state, 3) Set up query invalidation strategies for real-time sync, 4) Create optimistic update patterns for GPIO controls, 5) Implement error boundary handling with React Error Boundary, 6) Set up Sentry integration for production monitoring
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: High complexity due to hybrid state management approach. TanStack Query already configured but needs integration with Zustand and real-time updates.

complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Build monitoring dashboard: 1) Create monitoring dashboard with Chart components for metrics, 2) Implement GPIO status overview with Badge and Progress components, 3) Design cluster health monitoring with status indicators, 4) Create real-time log viewer with ScrollArea and Table, 5) Implement customizable dashboard widgets with drag-and-drop, 6) Add data export functionality for CSV/JSON formats
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: Medium-high complexity. Chart components available via recharts dependency. Requires real-time data integration and complex dashboard layout management.

complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Create API integration layer: 1) Create src/api directory with modular clients for auth, GPIO, clusters, monitoring, 2) Implement axios instance with authentication interceptors, 3) Set up retry logic with exponential backoff, 4) Create comprehensive TypeScript interfaces for API responses, 5) Add request caching strategies complementing TanStack Query
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: Medium-high complexity. No existing API layer found. Requires comprehensive TypeScript definitions and integration with existing TanStack Query setup.

complexityAnalysis.taskTitle: Configure Build System and Development Environment
complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Configure build system: 1) Update vite.config.ts with Socket.io development proxy, 2) Configure environment variable management for different environments, 3) Set up build optimizations for Socket.io bundling and tree shaking, 4) Add TypeScript path mapping for new feature directories
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: Medium complexity. Basic Vite config exists and just needs extensions. Environment setup and path mapping are standard configurations.

complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Implement security and error handling: 1) Set up input validation and sanitization with zod schemas, 2) Configure Content Security Policy headers and CSRF protection, 3) Create comprehensive error boundary system, 4) Implement secure session management with proper token storage, 5) Set up Sentry integration for error monitoring, 6) Create audit logging for sensitive operations
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: High complexity due to security requirements, comprehensive error handling, and production monitoring setup. Critical for GPIO and cluster operations.

complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Build node management interface: 1) Create NodeManagement component with hardware information display, 2) Implement node health monitoring with real-time status indicators, 3) Design GPIO pin assignment interface for hardware configurations, 4) Create node clustering workflow with drag-and-drop assignment, 5) Implement node provisioning forms with hardware detection, 6) Add node performance metrics visualization
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: High complexity due to hardware-specific interfaces, real-time monitoring, and complex node assignment workflows. Requires integration with GPIO and cluster systems.

complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Establish testing infrastructure: 1) Set up Vitest and React Testing Library for component testing, 2) Create mock implementations for Socket.io, GPIO APIs, and auth services, 3) Implement integration tests for authentication flows and real-time updates, 4) Set up E2E testing with Playwright for critical workflows, 5) Implement visual regression testing for shadcn/ui components
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: Medium-high complexity. No existing testing infrastructure found. Requires comprehensive mocking of complex real-time and hardware systems.

complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Optimize application performance: 1) Implement code splitting for pi-controller features with React.lazy, 2) Set up lazy loading for non-critical components and routes, 3) Optimize Socket.io client configuration for minimal bundle impact, 4) Implement service worker for offline GPIO state caching, 5) Set up performance monitoring with Web Vitals and custom metrics
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: Medium complexity. Standard React optimization techniques. Vite already provides good build optimization foundation.

complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Prepare production deployment: 1) Create production build configuration with environment-specific optimizations, 2) Set up deployment scripts and CI/CD pipeline integration, 3) Create comprehensive documentation for features, API integration, and deployment, 4) Implement production monitoring with health checks and error alerting
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: Medium complexity. Standard deployment preparation tasks. Benefits from existing Vite build system and clear project structure.
